sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: A Possessed creature is a source-linked conduit for the Ritualist's Rites. Individual Ritualism cards may establish, trigger, modify, transfer, or consume Possessed.

sections.label: ECHO
sections.html: The first time each round one of that Ritualist's Rites triggers because of their Possessed creature, resolve that Echo without reducing the Rite's remaining Echoes.

sections.label: LIMIT
sections.html: A creature can have only one Possessed condition at a time.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
